rows: Supposedly this Halloween party will be a special one! And people who were not invited cannot not get in!\I see...\CheckQuestState,2,3\*\*block
For someone that already knows why are you so curious? That reminds me, you completed the errand I gave you right?\Oh yeah\11
For this year's party only a small number of special people, such as myself, have been invited.\Special people?\Quest_Check,4,6,7,8\*\*block

Well depending on if you received an invitation or not, that's a quick way to figure out if you are special or not... Hm now that I take a closer look at you, it seems like you didn't receive an invitation... Tsk tsk... Don't worry to much though! If you run an errand for me then I will get you an invitation~\Don't need it\Exit\What kind of errand?\5

I just need you to bring me 10 Pumpkins. It's a simple request right? Consider yourself an especially lucky person to be given such a chance! If you bring me the pumpkins I will give you a leftover invitation!\No way\Exit\Okay\Quest_Accept,q0,q1,9\@\@img,64366
What do you expect me to do with these plain looking pumpkins?\What do you mean plain?\12
There isn't much time! You should be able to easily acquire 10 Pumpkins from Farmer Tsetsech.\OK, I'm on it\Exit
You know ones that look scary and could be used as decorations for the Halloween party!\Okay\Quest_Check_1,14,15,16,17\@\@img,64368
If you bring me a carved pumpkin then I will give you an invitation.\Ug, forget it!\Exit\What are you looking for?\13
I heard that Lethos is in the Southeast Forest.\OK\Exit

I have no more business with you! Stop lingering around here and go far away!\Awww...\Exit

I even ordered a special outfit just for this Halloween! An outfit that commoners would never get to wear ever in their lifetime! But... Louis... That guy... He won't deliver it?! Just cause he thinks he's something special...\I'll let you handle that\Exit\Halloween Outfit?\Quest_Check,3,4,5,6\*\*block

A newbie like you is going to bring me an invitation?! Pfft! What a joke! Instead, there is someone here who reeks of information. Talk to this person and find out all the information you can!\Who is that person?\Quest_Accept_1,q0,q1,16\*\*block
Took you long enough... Tell that Louis Bitton, if I ever run into him, he'll wish that he delivered this with his own two hands!\Okay\Quest_Complete,q2,q3,6\*\*block

You know what, I am calm, I don't even care about this Halloween party anymore! I will spare no expense to destroy this party!\I can't help you with that!\Exit\Calm down! I'll get an invitation!\Quest_Check_1,12,13,14,15\*\*block
From Megalopolis, head northeast and you'll see a portal to Event Garden. Louis Bitton should be there. Go right now!\Yes ma'am!\Exit
Louis, that jerk! Once I get my hands on him I won't let him go! He expects me to go to a Halloween party in this abomination of a dress?!\Sorry!\Exit

This year's Halloween party can only be attended by those who recieved invitations! I am someone who receives the best service no matter where I go! I can only see this as a clear challenge towards me! I don't know who's smart idea this party was, but I will not forgive him!\Calm down...\11\*\*block
I'm so busy right now, that I don't have time to go there either! Hey, you look pretty free right now... Go get my Halloween outfit for me!\No way\Exit\Yes ma'am!\Quest_Accept,q0,q1,7\*\*block
Don't stand here and dawdle! Quickly go and get me my information!

name: NpcMsg_Path_NE_Npc177_3mon1
rows: Regardless of the fact that it's summer the power of the moon is still very strong...\Boooooring!\Exit\Really? How Strong?\CheckQuestState,8,1
Under this kind of moon light even a normal person could go crazy.\That's pretty strong\ActiveQuestID_0,2,21
You need something. Are you going to ask me? You should not waste my time, I guard space and time itself!\Sorry, nevermind\Exit\See there's this werewolf...\Quest_Check,3,7,17,8

Ah yes, Lycan's wish to stop time. I am the guardian of time, not the controller. Lycan's situation is unfortunate, but I cannot go against time by my own hands. There are Rules about this sort of thing.\There has to be a way!\4

It's not that there is no way... However, the way that does exist is not an easy one. I doubt you have the strength and mental fortitude to undergo the quest you will need to complete. But if you still think that you want to do it, then I won't stop you...\I'll just give up then\18\I won't fail!\5

Then listen carefully. The reason that Lycan turns into a violent werewolf during the full moon is not because of the full moon. The issue is Lycan's blood. The only thing the full moon does is stimulate a specific element that is in his blood. Basically, the blood goes into a sort of overdrive. Luckily, there is a medicine that was discovered long ago that is able to prevent that from happening.\Medicine?\6

Yes, but there was a problem. The medication was too strong for some people to handle. It could jeopardize people's lives. Compounders reached an agreement that this medication should be outlawed. They tore the prescription into 6 pieces and buried them in the ground. But if you trully want to help Lycan, collect those torn prescription pieces. I will tell you more about the whole process once you bring those. What do you think?\I am not too sure\18\I can do it!\Quest_Accept,q0,q1,16\@\@,img,i63501,i63502,i63503,i63504,i63505,i63506

Lycan is lucky to have such a helpful friend like you. However this is only the beginning. We have a long way to go. Take this restored prescription first.\I changed my mind\19\OK...\Quest_Complete,q2,q3,8
Now that we have the prescription, what do you think should be the next step?\Prepare the medication?\Quest_Check_1,9,10,17,11

That's right. Take this prescription to Compounder Paul. He is young and naive so he won't be against preparing this medication. Come back once you have the medication. Bring 5 just in case.\I'm tired\18\I'll be right back!\Quest_Accept_1,q0,q1,16\@\@,img,i63499

Well done, you brought the medication. It's been such a long time since the last time I saw this medication. Keep this medication with you and give it to Lycan later. Let him know that he needs to take it before meeting the princess. Oh and don't consume it.\No eating it... OK\Quest_Complete_1,q2,q3,11
Okay, we're on our last step. Are you still with me?\I'm losing it\18\Yes, I am\Quest_Check_2,12,15,17,20

Listen up. If Lycan is discovered by anyone else in the castle, that would be the end of him. Which means they need to meet up at a secluded area. On the day of the Treasure Hunt, I will open up a space for them to meet. This would be against the Rules but since you've made such an effort to help him, it would be cruel to not help. But there is a catch to this.\Catch?\13

When I open up the space, Lycan and Princess Rosetta will be moved to the same place. They both need to have a Time Trap Stone on their person in order for the teleportation to work. Time Trap Stones work as magnets that will bring two people together when I cast a spell on them. Is that clear?\Yes I understand\14

A perfect Time Trap Stone is a rare find. If you get lucky, you may be able to find one on the first try, but the chances of that happening is very low. Why don't you bring me Triangular Stones instead? Bring 10 of them and I'll pick the one that I could use. This should be easy, right?\I don't think I can do this\18\Of course!\Quest_Accept_2,q0,q1,16\@\@,img,i63508

It's complete. You went out of your way to help Lycan... humans can be so reckless sometimes. The stage for Lycan and Rosetta is set now. Now it all lays in the hands of fate. These two Time Trap Stones are for Lycan and Rosetta. Give it to them. Oh and this is something I prepared for you.\Eh... this is work\19\Thanks!\Quest_Complete_2,q2,q3,20
I am afraid your level may be too low to speak to me, the Guardian of Time and Space.\Leave\Exit
I see that you're still working on it. Don't make me wait too long.\Leave\Exit
You won't help anyone with that weak will of yours.\Leave\Exit
You have shown me the true meaning of selfishness. Go away.\Leave\Exit
Selflessness is a thing of beauty. I am deeply moved by you. I will never forget this day.\Leave\Exit
What brings you here? Are you helping Lycan too?
Those prescriptions should be buried all over in the grounds of Paradise Fields. Good luck.\Leave\Exit

While you were searching for the torn prescriptions, I asked Compounder Paul to meet you by the Path of Ghost Blue in the Southeast Forest. Go talk to him. I bet he would be scared there because of all the monsters. Good luck.\Leave\Exit
Triangular Stones can be obtained from the Cone Stones in a Dark Cave in Coral Beach. Don't give up now.\Leave\Exit
You're just going to waste all that effort!

name: NpcMsg_WDG_Npc187_SH
rows: Oh? How are you here when you're only level 100? You're a weird kid\Leave\Exit
It really was a lie, wasn't it? You... So boring.\Leave\Exit

...What? You met Favian inside? ...What are you talking about? Are you dreaming? Favian has been here the whooole time telling me that he never wants to go back inside. As you can see, this guy is a scaredy cat.\I'm telling you I really saw him!\22

... Hm? Looking at  your expression... It looks like you were telling the truth? Hm... Can you go into more detail about it? I'm really interested in urban legends. So what exactly happened?\Start explaning\23

Why are you so horrified? You're body seems a bit weak. Oh my, don't tell me you forcefully followed me here, when your so weak. Well accept this, and quickly go back. Tsk tsk It's good to play games, but think about your body too.\Don't accept\27\Accept\Quest_Complete,q2,q3,28
Why do I have to come all the way here like this?!\Show interest\CheckQuestState,20,1\Not interested\Exit
You know, I came all the way out here and the Favian who said he would collect all the urban legends for me is now saying something else? Sigh...\Listen to conversation\EventTalkStart
Oh my, why won't you accept it when I'm giving it to you? You really are weird.\Wait a bit\Exit

And I'm telling you, we were here the whole time. So how were you able to meet Favian inside? You, you're a bit weird, huh? Are you sure you're not the ghost? Ho ho ho ...I'm sure that's not the case though.\Th.. The guy I met wa.. was a gho... ahhhh!!\31

You don't look too good... Are you sure you're okay? Don't start telling me it's my fault. Take this and head out. I'm sure we'll run into each other again one of these days. Okay then bye\You say good bye and then leave\Exit

Still? Where's the Joey's Fantastic Hand Mirror, Weird Radio, Cochma's Educational DVD, and Tricks for 1st place? Are you sure you were telling me the truth about all the things that happened inside? You were lying, huh? Hmmm?\Wait a bit! I'm telling the truth!\Exit
Anyways, what are you doing here? Did you follow me?\Leave her alone\Exit\Try talking to her\Quest_Check,21,24,25,28

Good thinking. Okay then quickly bring me Joey's Fantastic Hand Mirror, Weird Radio, Cochma's Educational DVD, and Tricks for 1st place. I'm sure you don't need those things anyways, right? If you bring those things to me then it'll be proof enough that you weren't lying, right? Okay~ come back quickly.

Oh my... Just listening to your story is interesting. Hm~ How about this? I'll believe your story so why don't you give me Joey's Fantastic Hand Mirror, Weird Radio, Cochma's Educational DVD, and Tricks for 1st place. If you do I'll give you something good. How about it?\Let me think about it for a bit\26\Okay I'll give it to you!\Quest_Accept,q0,q1,29

name: NpcMsg_WDG_Npc85_SH
rows: Hm? Mirror... If you're talking about the Fantastic Hand Mirror then yes I do have it, but... Ah please don't misunderstand! I wasn't keeping it so I could look at myself... Some one just happened to leave it behind class.\Can I borrow it?\9\Oh, I see...\12

Well, it's not like I can't let you borrow it, but... I need you to return it to me, so I won't let you borrow it for free. That's okay right? There are some things that I wanted to see, but I'm to scared to go inside because it's so dangerous.\I'd rather not\12\I'm free, I'll help\Quest_Accept,q0,q1,15
Ah! Another person... Sigh~ To meet looking like this...\Never mind...\Exit\I heard you had a mirror?\Quest_Check,8,10,11,14

No matter how much of these things I have, I don't think it will make me successful on the test... Sigh. But since I promised, here's the Fantastic Hand Mirror. After you're done with it, take it to Favian. He'll tell you what to do next~ Okay then bye.\Next stop, to the Weird Girl~\Exit
What are you talking about?! That's really not why I'm wearing it! I just wanted to pass my test!\Uh... Kay...\Exit
Ah~ a person! I didn't think anyone would come to this ghost infested Phantom School... Ack~ I'm so embarrassed being caught wearing a dress~\I'll leave you alone\Exit\What's with the skirt?\1

Please don't misunderstand me. The reason I am like this is because of the legend that's tied to this tree swing. Other students call this the "success swing" and if you swing on this while wearing a blue skirt you will definitely succeed on a test. So that's why I gathered up my courage and came to this ghost infested school... But I got caught! *cries*\It's OK to wear a skirt...\3\Where'd the ghost come from?\2

I'm not really sure on the details either, but supposedly some of the students stayed behind after school and were playing around with a planchette.  Because of that, many spirits were summoned and those summoned spirits decided to occupy the school. Luckily the spirits only occupy the inside of the school and don't come out here. If you go inside the school, it'll probably get dangerous.\Oh, thanks, I'll go now\Exit\What's the school like?\4

Really? Thank you! What I need is a Red Rosary, Brown Rosary, Old Hand Knife, and Rice Cake. Just bring me 1 of each... I'll be waiting for you!! You can acquire the Red Rosary from the Ugly Corpse, the Brown Rosary from Frozen Corpse, and the Old Hand Knife from the Maiden Ghost. The Blue Goblin has the Rice Cakes.
